title: Mario's glove seen on the shiny floor of the craft
summary: Michael Johnson tells of Mario's glove seen on the shiny floor of the craft, about November 1977 at Aboard craft, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Aboard craft, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I was lying down somewhere and there was a glove on a floor, a real shiny floor, nothing like the inside of that truck.

plain: An Air Force veteran named Michael Johnson says that in November 1977, during a night he and fellow airman Mario Woods spent in the nuclear missile field at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, he found himself lying down somewhere and saw a glove on a very shiny floor, nothing like the inside of their truck. He ties it to the right glove Woods later found missing, which if true would mean both men remember the same object from inside a craft.
